Fourth-pass final correction for the minimal event-driven Onslaught source-reconstruction touch bridge. The third-pass architecture is preferred: do not modify main.js and do not load/patch production mobile assets. Fix these concrete review findings: (1) the proposed #source-touch-controls and especially #src-look are interactive immediately after boot and would cover/intercept the centered start menu on touch devices. The touch root must be hidden AND non-interactive while window.game.state.running is false, then become visible/interactive only while running; when it becomes inactive it must release all held keys/fire/ADS and clear active pointer ids. Do this with an explicit active class/state sync, not merely opacity. (2) source-reconstruction/index.html still lacks the production-style viewport lock. Add maximum-scale=1.0,user-scalable=no while preserving viewport-fit=cover and add theme-color if useful. Keep overscroll/touch-action protection and safe-area-aware controls. (3) Make pointerup/pointercancel/lostcapture handlers prevent default/stop propagation where appropriate so touch controls cannot leak compatibility clicks/mouse input. (4) Preserve the event-driven approach: synthesize existing key/mouse handlers and directly update public state.yaw/pitch; no new main.js API. (5) Update source-specific smoke coverage to verify the root exists but is non-interactive before gameplay and includes all required move/look/fire/ADS/reload/slide/weapon controls; do not pretend the smoke test can prove physical touch geometry. Return a syntactically coherent unified diff for only source-reconstruction/index.html, source-reconstruction/src/mobile-source-bridge.js and scripts/smoke-onslaught.mjs unless another file is truly necessary. Do not claim tests were run.
